summary_1line: Angered kings attack after Draupadi’s choice; Bhima and Arjuna defend, while Krishna recognizes the disguised Pandavas and Arjuna duels Karna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima uproots a massive tree and stands beside Arjuna like a mace‑wielding god as enraged kings charge toward them.
Krishna quietly points out the disguised Pandavas to Balarama while watching the chaos of armed kings rushing the arena.
Arjuna and Karna unleash torrents of arrows so fast that their bodies disappear behind the storm of shafts.
